scripts.update:all: npm run update && concurrently --timings "npm run update:other3" "npm run update:other4" "npm run update:v3" "npm run update:v4"
scripts.build:all: concurrently --timings "npm run build:other3" "npm run build:other4" "npm run build:v3" "npm run build:v4"
scripts.build:all:offline: concurrently --timings "npm run build:other3:offline" "npm run build:other4:offline" "npm run build:v3:offline" "npm run build:v4:offline"
scripts.pack:other3: npm run build:other3 && node scripts/build-pack.js other3
scripts.pack:other4: npm run build:other4 && node scripts/build-pack.js other4
scripts.pack:v3: npm run build:v3 && node scripts/build-pack.js v3
scripts.pack:v4: npm run build:v4 && node scripts/build-pack.js v4
scripts.pack:other3:offline: npm run build:other3:offline && node scripts/build-pack.js other3 --offline
scripts.pack:other4:offline: npm run build:other4:offline && node scripts/build-pack.js other4 --offline
scripts.pack:v3:offline: npm run build:v3:offline && node scripts/build-pack.js v3 --offline
scripts.pack:v4:offline: npm run build:v4:offline && node scripts/build-pack.js v4 --offline
